title: Rosey's Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Rosey's Retreat at Villas at Sunset Beach offers a luxurious escape in Seacrest, Florida, perfect for those seeking a blend of comfort and coastal elegance. This three-bedroom, three-bathroom 30A vacation home boasts breathtaking Gulf views from the living area and a spacious balcony, inviting guests to soak in the serene beauty of the coast. The fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and a dining area overlooking the Gulf ensures delightful culinary experiences and memorable meals with loved ones. Each bedroom is designed for ultimate relaxation, featuring plush bedding, Smart TVs, and en suite bathrooms, providing a private sanctuary for every guest. Beyond the exquisite interiors, Rosey's Retreat enhances your stay with thoughtful amenities, including complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a full-size washer and dryer, and two bikes for exploring the picturesque surroundings. A complimentary round of golf each day adds a touch of leisure and adventure to your vacation. Nestled on the southside of 30A in Seacrest Beach, this Gulf-front haven is an idyllic spot for beach lovers and those looking to unwind in style. Experience the perfect blend of home-like conveniences and luxurious coastal living at Rosey's Retreat, where every detail is curated for an unforgettable stay.
